tactical_thesis: Deploy Hibiscus before Ansel so both boosts cover the first shared artillery barrage. Reserve Spot's first healing skill for the second barrage instead of spending it on the first. Preserve the central blockers, then rotate Steward from eastern artillery coverage to direct coverage of both blocked central lanes. Midnight's second arts window and returning Melantha bridge the caster's redeployment interval. Finish all four roadblocks through staged clearance. This is a complete, statically checked hypothesis without a new simulation or claimed WIN.
